label: sequence began with g: late original phase through <DEL>
explanation: Fires in sequences whose first (or second) original token is g. It is silent at t=0-2, then turns on and grows from t=3 to the end of the original phase. It peaks around the last original tokens and the <DEL> step, then decays over the first one or two copy steps (recall_idx 0-1). Magnitude is driven by g being at the very start: first_tok==g covers 84% of top-quartile activations, and sequences opening with a run of g (g g g ...) reach the maximum. g at position 1 gives moderate activations, and g at position 2 or later gives weak ones. It barely fires in the later copy phase or at t<3. A weak diffuse tail (low-quartile, about 24% of mass) fires late in the original phase and at <DEL> in sequences with no early g, and some of it involves g later in the sequence. This tail is not captured. Dev: P=0.80, R=0.56, F1=0.66, mass recall=0.76.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=g (+8.25), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+7.37), next_out=g (+6.61), phase=2 & out_tok=g (+4.99), orig1=g (+4.85), t=3 & prev_tok=d (+4.43). Lower it: phase=2 (-10.71), prev2_tok=- (-8.38), out_tok=d (-6.59), out_tok=c (-5.51).
